function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date, including temperature, precipitation, and wind conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic location for the forecast, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the forecast is being retrieved, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

temperature_unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature.

include_humidity.description: Whether to include humidity percentage in the forecast.

include_wind.description: Whether to include wind speed and direction in the forecast.

After retiring from active business, Reddy entered public life as a member of the legislative assembly in the state of Telangana, representing the constituency of Yellandu. During his tenure he served on several parliamentary committees and was appointed Minister of State for Rural Development, where he championed policies aimed at improving infrastructure and livelihoods in underserved areas.  

Beyond his political work, Reddy established the **Shashi Tej Reddy Foundation**, a charitable organization that funds educational scholarships, rural health clinics and community development projects throughout central and southern India. His efforts have earned him national recognition, including the Padma Shri award for social service.
